iterations.name: register-cap trials for sampler-variant fragment shaders
iterations.note: trials conclude: 2 CAPPED, 3 left-as-built; median unmoved (24.51 vs 24.53) — slow launches are per-warp efficient, occupancy was not their limiter. Kept: self-selecting, near-zero cost, helps register-bound variants elsewhere. Gates: 43/43, 5-mode hashes unchanged.

iterations.name: fuse fragment chain on the direct shade path (interpolate into generated fs)
iterations.note: -0.3ms median, sweep 30.41->29.81; 3 launches->2 per direct shade, fs_in round-trip intra-kernel; all gates incl. 6-mode hashes + both sentinel sets; enables writeback fusion; commit a9a952f1c09

iterations.name: fuse clipping into raster stage 1; preserve machine-wide queue consumers
iterations.note: clip+s1: 23.421/23.672 vs flag-off 24.070; sweep 29.17->28.51; Crossroads 7.480; 43/43, 6-mode hashes unchanged, both sentinels exact. Rejected clip+s1+s2: 27.21/27.27 because producer-local warps serialized queue consumption. Persistent/machine-scaled consumer required.

iterations.name: fuse vertex fetch into the generated vertex shader
iterations.note: global-buffer helper ABI regressed partial replay 23.5->48.05ms; trivial VS 20->108 regs, 6->2 blocks/SM. Lane-local form invalid across LLVM local/NVRTC generic pointer ABI. All source reverted. Viable only with separate classic/fused binaries plus address-space-correct local result ABI and occupancy-tier selection.

iterations.name: resource-isolate classic and fused fragment binaries; A/B the whole chain
iterations.note: resource isolation worked (cpvk_tri 190->18 regs) but 64/65 old-capture textured FS kept identical 203/236 regs; sampler graph dominates. Classic chain 24.764/24.730 vs fused 23.652/23.531 (+1.156ms). All source reverted. Hardware texture execution is required before retry.

iterations.name: hardware texture-object execution for admitted 2D descriptors
iterations.note: isolated PITCH2D hardware path hit 14.1%; uncapped 203->190 regs still 1 block and lost +0.220ms. Independent cap reached 126 regs/2 blocks with 104B+ spill, but interleaved center HW 23.608 vs off 23.605 (+0.003ms neutral). Fully reverted. Needs broad mipmapped arrays/cube/3D/BC plus same-LLVM interpolation.

iterations.name: occupancy-sized persistent fragment launch grid
iterations.note: exact direct grid4096 counts p50 3108, mean 46196, only 4.406% initial lanes useful; abuf 99.96%. Fixed 340-2048 grids all within 0.16% of 4096 control spread; no justified auto policy. Reverted.

iterations.name: pre-interpolate in compact kernel; bare hardware-texture FS execution
iterations.note: bare HW FS 34-79 regs/3-6 blocks, but only 13.6% direct hits; full center HW 23.885 vs off 23.818 (+0.067). Trace: admitted chain 33.348->17.648us, texture works; low coverage. Multi-mip predicts ~22% coverage near break-even; full arrays upper bound 0.31-1.05ms, no-go. Reverted.

iterations.name: split trivial clip accept from heavy polygon clipping
iterations.note: 98.783% trivial (71.898 inside,26.886 reject,1.217 cross), resource split worked but extra launch/worklist/reclassification raised device direct 30.992->41.021us, abuf 12.401->14.804us and replay +0.850ms. Reverted. Needs one persistent heterogeneous scheduler, not two kernels.

iterations.name: zero-copy primitive references for trivially accepted clipping
iterations.note: zero-copy refs remove ~71.25MB/frame accepted writes; old 23.682->23.255 (-0.427), sweep 28.42->25.99, Crossroads neutral. Direct clip+s1 -14.4%, abuf -12.1%. 43/43, six-mode unchanged, sanitizer clean, sentinels/NVIDIA gates pass.

iterations.name: cache huge-primitive setup across stage3 tiles
iterations.note: cache setups for >=4 tiles; stage3 direct -2.45%, abuf -2.35%, old 23.295->23.217 (-0.077). 1024 entries/qset, 756KiB total, overflow exact. Sample hot excludes nondet glTF: 17.12 vs17.16; full gates pass.

iterations.name: explicit update-free CUDA graph for raster tail
iterations.note: measure-first stop: 318k chains/65.9k exact keys; LRU hit 69-77%, two-touch still 27k-44k instantiations, 11-183MiB cache, 0.27-0.43ms/frame builds vs 0.63-0.68ms gap ceiling. Source restored. Whole-batch graphs need stable command-owned slots.

iterations.name: exact fixed-edge raster oracle and all-stage migration
iterations.note: production rejected: fixed mode4 +0.740ms vs legacy and +0.225ms vs fixed direct despite exact oracle/path matrix. Production restored. Retain cpvk_fixed_edge shared-edge CPU oracle; shadow census was not completed.

iterations.name: same-LLVM fragment interpolation and shader
iterations.note: same-LLVM LLVM18/clang bitcode interpolation proven; no helper/local/fs_in traffic. Inline 38/65 shaders, focused direct -25.3%, abuf -16.4%, but old neutral vs fused and opt-in ownership +8.34s/+110.6MB. Default remains fused; INLINE_FS=1 enables. Full correctness/review/static/no-clang gates pass.

iterations.name: same-LLVM hardware texture execution
iterations.note: same-LLVM HW worked (88 regs, 2 blocks, no spill; focused chains 8-12us faster) but only 13.9% launches hit; old HW 23.366 vs SW23.336 center +0.031ms. Fully restored. Arrays still need >29% direct weighted coverage.

iterations.name: same-LLVM specialized software sampler
iterations.note: proof sampler reaches 54 regs RGBA8/56 BC3, exact implicit; explicit LOD 122/131072 word mismatches. Whole-launch rich key only 25.85% FS time (<60), so no src edits. Per-row broad ceiling 58% overall/94.33% abuf motivates bounded row-key dispatch.

iterations.name: bounded per-row LLVM sampler dispatch
iterations.note: measure exact row keys/live slots, then compile up to two per-row literal software sampler paths inside one LLVM FS module; coherent key-index branch, no generic sampler link, whole fused fallback for unmapped rows. Targets 58% FS time/94% abuf ceiling without extra launches.
